HelpTopics.Topic: The project is a single .NET 10.0 Windows Forms application. Source files live alongside the .csproj. Models are under Models/, Fluent NHibernate maps are under Maps/, and the main entry point is Program.cs.

Database access is handled by Fluent NHibernate with SQL Server as the backend. DbConfig.cs configures the session factory and connection. A JSON config file (dbconfig.json) stores the active database name and connection details.

Microsoft.Web.WebView2 — embeds Chromium-based web content inside WinForms. FluentNHibernate — fluent mappings for NHibernate. ReaLTaiizor — Material Design controls for WinForms. System.Data.SqlClient — SQL Server data access.
Shown at startup. Displays application info (name, version, author, framework, database, dependencies) fetched from the database. Click the close button (X) to dismiss and proceed to the main form.
Single-form application with a MenuStrip (File, Edit, View, Settings, Help), a StatusStrip with a live clock, and a TabControl. The World Map tab embeds a WebView2 control that loads Google Maps.
File — New, Open, Save, Exit. Edit — Copy, Paste. View — Toggle Fullscreen (F11), About. Settings — Preferences. Help — Contents, About (F1).
Displayed at the bottom of the main form. Shows a "Ready" label on the left and a live-updating clock (refreshes every second) on the right.

On first launch (or when the configured database is unavailable), a Database Setup dialog appears. Enter a database name and click Create. The app creates the database, tables, and seed data automatically.

Double-click RunMe.bat to launch, or run "dotnet run --project WinformsVibes.csproj" from a terminal. You can also build with "dotnet build" and run the compiled exe directly from bin/Debug/net10.0-windows/.
The active database is stored in dbconfig.json (next to the exe). Edit the "DatabaseName" field to switch, or delete the file to trigger the setup dialog again on next launch.
Help topics are stored in the HelpInfo table and can be browsed from the Help menu. Select a topic to view its content in a dialog.
